usage: 凍奶茶 is a noun and refers to a cold milk tea drink.
You can use 凍奶茶 as the subject or object in a sentence.
凍奶茶 can be combined with verbs like 喝 (to drink) or 買 (to buy).
It is common to ask for 凍奶茶 in restaurants or shops as a refreshing drink.
凍奶茶 can also be used with quantifiers like 杯 (cup) to specify quantity.
